name: YouTube Watch Later
description: Bookmark your favourite YouTube's URL to watch later. While watching video on YouTube's website, you can click the red heart icon to add YouTube's URL to your watch later list. Once you have some items in your list, you can search through them easily by typing @yt + space + keyword or tag (tag started with #) + enter in address bar. Type @yt + space + enter in address bar to view all saved bookmarks. Your bookmarks will be stored in browser storage. You can import and export your bookmarks from the listing page (type @yt + space + enter in address bar)
author: 8columns
